europe_now.title: Severe Storms and Flooding in France
europe_now.summary: Severe weather has caused significant flooding and at least four fatalities in southern France. The extreme conditions pose ongoing safety risks across the affected areas.

sources.headline: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France

europe_now.title: Global Cybersecurity Alert Regarding PHP Flaw
europe_now.summary: Hackers have initiated millions of attempts to exploit a widespread PHP security vulnerability worldwide. Cybersecurity experts are tracking the threat as systems face high volumes of malicious traffic.

sources.headline: Hackers launch ‘millions’ of attempts to exploit global PHP cyber flaw

top_stories.title: International Criminal Court Awarded Human Rights Prize
top_stories.summary: The European Parliament has awarded the International Criminal Court its top human rights honor. The recognition comes despite ongoing opposition and sanctions from the United States administration.

sources.headline: International Criminal Court wins EU’s top human rights prize in defiance of Trump’s sanctions
🔴 International Criminal Court wins EU's Sakharov human rights prize

top_stories.title: French Protest Restrictions and Unrest
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has directed local authorities to restrict upcoming weekend demonstrations exclusively to union-led marches. The measures follow waves of protests and civil unrest in the country.
